name: Fetch
description: Fetch web pages with a real JS-rendering headless browser. Tool: Fetch.

tool.name: Fetch
tool.description: Fetch a webpage and return its rendered content. Runs the page through a real headless browser (JS executes, dynamic content loads) and returns the result in the requested format. Prefer this over Bash+curl when the page needs JavaScript to render or when you need clean markdown for reading. Returns raw page text in `content`.

url.description: The page URL. Must start with http:// or https://. Max 4096 chars.

format.description: Output format. 'markdown' is the default and best for reading articles/docs. 'text' is plain text (no markup). 'html' is the rendered HTML. 'links' returns just the page's links. 'original' streams the raw response body verbatim - use for images, JSON, JS, CSS, or any non-HTML resource.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector. The browser waits for this element before returning. Useful for SPAs where the interesting content arrives after initial load.

eval.description: Optional JavaScript expression to evaluate in the page context. When set, the eval result is what gets returned instead of the page body. Power-user feature - most callers don't need this.

wait_until.description: When to consider navigation complete. 'load' = window load event (default). 'domcontentloaded' = HTML parsed (faster, may miss async content). 'networkidle0' = no network activity for 500ms (slowest, best for SPAs/dynamic pages).

timeout_sec.description: Navigation timeout in seconds. Bump this for slow or dynamic pages.

cleanup.description: Whitespace cleanup for `markdown`/`text` only (no-op for html/links/original). 'basic' (default): rstrip per line, collapse 2+ blank runs, trim ends. Safe paragraph separation preserved. 'aggressive': basic + fold unicode whitespace (NBSP, ideographic space, etc.) to ASCII + strip zero-width chars (ZWSP, BOM, ZWJ) + drop all remaining blank lines. Use 'aggressive' when the page is noisy (Bloomberg / Wikipedia / GitHub nav lists wrap every block in blank lines, ~30%+ of the file). 'off' = passthrough; only use when verbatim bytes matter. The pre-cleanup raw bytes are always preserved at the blob path in the `<ma::agent::raw-output .../>` footer.

session.description: Optional session name to keep cookies + localStorage alive across calls. Use the same name for related fetches and the second call comes back logged in. Names are alnum + `-`/`_`, max 64 chars; the plugin sandboxes them under `~/.minimal-agent/sessions/fetch/<name>/` so the model cannot escape to arbitrary disk paths. Use when a workflow needs to stay logged in (Twitter scrape across pages, LinkedIn search across companies, etc.); first call logs in via `eval` form-submit, subsequent calls reuse the saved session. Omit for stateless one-shot fetches: the default is no persistence. Pass an empty string to override a config-default session for one call.
